title: GitHub Portfolio Search
one_liner: Semantic search engine for personal GitHub repositories using embeddings and TF-IDF.
what_it_is: A tool that indexes GitHub repositories, extracts README content, generates embeddings, and provides a searchable interface via CLI, Web UI, and MCP server. It allows developers to find reusable code patterns and architectures across their own portfolio.
how_its_built: Python backend using sentence-transformers for embeddings and SQLite-vec for vector storage. FastAPI serves the REST API. The web frontend is static HTML/JS consuming JSON exports. AWS Lambda handles OAuth and logging. GitHub Actions automate weekly reindexing.
how_to_apply: Clone the repo, configure a GitHub token, run the indexing pipeline on your username, and serve the web UI or use the CLI/MCP server to search your codebase semantically.
quickstart:
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/github-portfolio-search.git
cd github-portfolio-search
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
cp .env.example .env
# Edit .env to add GITHUB_TOKEN
ghps index <your_github_username>
ghps export
cd web && python3 -m http.server 8000
features: Semantic search using embeddings and TF-IDF across READMEs and code
Auto-clustering of repositories into capability categories
CLI, Web UI, and MCP server interfaces for AI agents
Faceted filtering by language, tech stack, and stars
Automated weekly reindexing via GitHub Actions
Exportable data formats (JSON/Markdown) and embeddable widgets
